title: 第1章 下坯村宋家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

清晨，太阳的第一缕阳光撒向大地，农家小院里的鸡早早开始叫起来，宋禾

农历三月初，空气中依旧带着一股寒意，风一吹，冷风只往人衣袖领口里钻。

宋禾紧了紧身上的衣裳，放下鸡食盆快步走进灶房，她得抓紧时间做饭，要不然陈桂花又能找到由头挖苦她。

正想着，一个尖锐的女声从外面传来。

“宋禾，饭做好了吗！”

宋禾微微提高声音，“好了。”

一个身材微胖的圆脸中年女人走进灶房，这便是宋禾这一世的母亲陈桂花。

陈桂花看了一眼放在灶台笸篮里的两个掺面窝窝头，微微皱眉，问：“怎么没菜？”

宋禾一手拿着汤勺搅拌锅里的粥，回答，“昨儿剩的野菜不多，余下那些我煮到粥里了。”

春季正是青黄不接的时候，农家菜还没长成，上年冬天腌的萝卜咸菜也已经吃完，几乎村里每家每户都靠着挖野菜给家里多个添头。

陈桂花瞥了一眼锅里的野菜粥，嘴上依旧不饶人，“知道家里吃菜多，你就不知道多挖些。”

宋禾抬了一下眼皮，道：“最近外面野菜虽然生的多，但架不住村里挖野菜的人更多。而且昨儿一天我都在后院煮染液，这些野菜还是下午抽时间去挖的。”

接着宋禾话锋一转，“不过，若是娘想吃，等我吃完早饭就立马出门挖野菜去。”

“那怎么行，上午还得往染缸里下染布。”陈桂花脱口而出。

宋禾眉头一挑，“总不能让家里没菜啊。”

陈桂花想也不想道：“算了算，没菜就没菜吧，又饿不死。快点盛饭，一会儿你爹要去外头给人家帮忙干活。”

每年开春，村里便有人家给屋顶铺新瓦，这年头人力不值钱，主家买些新瓦片，请几个亲朋好友过去帮忙铺瓦，中午供人吃顿午饭就算成了。

宋禾没动，反问：“我盛饭？爹今天早上不吃鸡蛋了？”

宋有根前阵子刚服徭役回来，整个人瘦了一大圈，如今得吃点好的补补身子，而农户人家“吃点好的”也就是吃个鸡蛋。

陈桂花向来把家里的东西看的都紧，鸡蛋和糖都牢牢的锁在柜子，不让其他人碰。

Page (1/3)

In the early morning, the first ray of sunlight shines on the earth, and the chickens in the farmyard begin to crow early. Song He

In early March of the lunar calendar, there is still a chill in the air. When the wind blows, the cold wind only penetrates into people's sleeves and collars.

Song He tightened her clothes, put down the chicken bowl and walked into the kitchen quickly. She had to hurry up and cook, otherwise Chen Guihua would find another reason to ridicule her.

Just as he was thinking about it, a sharp female voice came from outside.

"Song He, is the meal ready?"

Song He raised his voice slightly, "Okay."

A middle-aged woman with a round face and a slightly plump figure walked into the kitchen. This was Chen Guihua, Song He's mother in this life.

Chen Guihua glanced at the two dough buns placed in the basket on the stove, frowned slightly, and asked, "Why is there no food?"

Song He stirred the porridge in the pot with a spoon in one hand and replied, "There weren't many wild vegetables left yesterday. I cooked the rest into the porridge."

Spring is the time when the harvest is slow, the farm vegetables have not yet grown, and the pickled radish and pickles last winter have been eaten up. Almost every household in the village relies on digging wild vegetables to add to the family.

Chen Guihua glanced at the wild vegetable porridge in the pot and said, "You know there are a lot of vegetables at home, so you don't know how to dig more."

Song He raised his eyelids and said: "Although there are a lot of wild vegetables growing outside recently, there are more people digging wild vegetables in the village. And I spent the whole day cooking dye liquid in the backyard yesterday, so I took the time to dig these wild vegetables in the afternoon."

Then Song He changed the subject, "But if mother wants to eat it, I will go out and dig wild vegetables immediately after I finish breakfast."

"How can that be done? I have to dye cloth in the dyeing vat in the morning." Chen Guihua blurted out.

Song He raised his eyebrows and said, "We can't let the family run out of food."

Chen Guihua said without thinking: "Forget it, if there is no food, there will be no food, and I won't die of hunger. Hurry up and serve the food, your father will go out to help others in a while."

Every spring, some families in the village lay new tiles on their roofs. Manpower is not valuable these days, so the owner buys some new tiles, invites a few relatives and friends to help lay the tiles, and provides lunch for everyone.

Song He didn't move and asked, "Should I serve the rice? Dad won't eat eggs this morning?"

Song Yougen had just returned from the corvee service a while ago and had lost a lot of weight. Now he had to eat something good to replenish his body, and for farmers, "eating something good" meant eating an egg.

Chen Guihua has always been very careful about everything at home. She keeps eggs and sugar tightly locked in the cupboard, preventing others from touching them.

Chen Guihua choked, took out the key, and turned around. Page (1/3)
